trip.title: China Winter Adventure 2026
trip.description: 11-day winter trip for two: Bangkok → Kunming → Chengdu → Jiuzhaigou → Chengdu → Shangri-La → Lijiang → Dali → Kunming → Xiamen → Bangkok. All timings and prices are planning estimates unless confirmed.

todos.title: Confirm travel dates and leave approval
Check passports and China entry requirements
Compare and book all flight legs
Verify Chengdu–Jiuzhaigou round-trip feasibility and rail/shuttle times
Check Chengdu–Shangri-La flight options and altitude adjustment
Book intercity trains and airport transfers
Book hotels for all ten nights
Check Jade Dragon Snow Mountain cableway ticket reservations
Check Jiuzhaigou winter entry and park shuttle availability
Set up Alipay or WeChat Pay

activities.notes: Very demanding day-trip plan. Verify train, shuttle, park opening hours and return connections before committing; otherwise stay overnight near Jiuzhaigou.

activities.notes: CRITICAL: Same-day return is not verified and may be infeasible. Do not book subsequent plans until confirmed.
